common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: The 2028 US Presidential Election – Consolidation
common.line: The United States elects a president, and advanced AI is treated as a strategic asset to be held rather than a product to be sold.

common.title: The 2028 US Presidential Election – Retrenchment
common.line: The anti-AI backlash decides the election and the incoming administration turns inward.

common.title: Member State Defection
common.line: A member state cuts its own arrangement – with a hyperscaler, with Washington, or with Beijing – on terms that undercut a position the Union has taken.

notable.title: Catastrophic Biological Incident
notable.line: A global biological outbreak caused by a pathogen designed with AI.
